prompt.project_info: Close-up side-profile portrait of an adult woman resting on a wet sandy beach at golden hour.
prompt.main_subject: One generic approved adult woman with wet dark-brown hair spread on sand, minimal water-resistant makeup, serene closed or slightly squinting eyes, wearing a white triangle bikini and gold pendant necklace; natural skin texture with seawater and sand grains.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 2:3 ground-level medium close-up, side profile with head tilted toward sky, face sharp and legs mostly out of frame; wet sand, wooden pier, palms, lush hill and calm sea behind with creamy bokeh.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Natural warm golden-hour side light, soft glow on face and shoulders, balanced shadows, peaceful humid tropical solitude after a swim.
prompt.technical_specs: High-end smartphone or DSLR look, shallow depth of field, sharp face, detailed wet hair and sand, realistic water sheen, natural color.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a vertical 2:3 photorealistic golden-hour beach portrait of one generic approved adult woman lying on her back on wet sand, serene eyes toward the sky, wet dark-brown hair spread on the sand, wearing a white triangle bikini and gold pendant necklace, seawater and sand texture visible, wooden pier, palms, green hill and calm sea softly blurred behind, warm natural side light.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, nudity, minors, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, explicit body-part emphasis, distorted anatomy, extra limbs, dry hair, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, logo overlay
